subject: Reliability

findings.subject: Reliability
findings.title: Database call on the request path has no transient-fault retry

evidence.excerpt: connection.Open(); ... var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction(); ... result = await connection.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync<int>(command);

findings.recommendation: Add a retry for transient SQL/Npgsql errors (driver-level retry logic or a Polly pipeline with finite attempts, exponential back-off and jitter, configured centrally) that wraps the whole open-connection/transaction unit rather than a single statement.

findings.subject: Reliability
findings.title: Synchronous database dependency on the request path has no circuit breaker
findings.recommendation: Register one long-lived resilience pipeline per database (e.g. Polly AddCircuitBreaker inside the retry, via AddResiliencePipeline) and handle the open-circuit outcome with a clear error so repeated DB failures fail fast.

findings.subject: Reliability
findings.title: No rate or concurrency limiter in the request pipeline
findings.recommendation: Add AddRateLimiter/UseRateLimiter early in the pipeline (limits from configuration, returning 429), especially for the destructive reset endpoint, or document the gateway rate-limit policy that fronts the service.

strengths.subject: Reliability
strengths.title: Database connect timeout is explicit and driven from configuration for both providers

strengths.subject: Reliability
strengths.title: Cancellation token flows from service to the Dapper command, and the transaction rolls back on failure

evidence.excerpt: new CommandDefinition(sqlScript, transaction: transaction, cancellationToken: cancellationToken); ... transaction.Rollback();

checkResults.subject: Reliability
checkResults.reason: Request-path database call has no retry and no built-in driver retry is configured (AZRL-05); AZRL-06…14 not applicable without retry logic.

checkResults.subject: Reliability
checkResults.reason: No retries, redelivery or distributed multi-step workflows in scope, so no AZRL-15…20 element applies.

checkResults.subject: Reliability
checkResults.reason: Synchronous database calls on the request path are not protected by any circuit breaker (AZRL-21).

checkResults.subject: Reliability
checkResults.reason: IaC not reviewed (advanced usage off); no deployment config in scope and no singleton component in code.

checkResults.subject: Reliability
checkResults.reason: The service exposes request endpoints but registers no rate or concurrency limiter in its pipeline (AZRL-32).

checkResults.subject: Reliability
checkResults.reason: No message consumers or background jobs in scope.

notes: REL-01 relies on library default SqlClient command timeout 30 s (Dapper CommandDefinition sets no commandTimeout); connect timeout 30 s from config. AZRL-02: no inbound timeout in scope. localized-standard-gap: unrecognized library Npgsql (inactive data source; default command timeout not localized). localized-standard-gap: unrecognized library OpenTelemetry OTLP exporter (export timeout default not localized; background telemetry, not request path).
